title: Pod Salt Core Grape Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pod Salt Core Grape Ice delivers the bold, fruity taste of ripe Grape with a fresh Menthol finish. Juicy and fragrant from the first inhale, this flavour captures the sweet intensity of dark grapes with a brisk icy exhale and smooth, satisfying exhale. Formulated with nicotine salts for smooth, rapid nicotine satisfaction, Grape Ice is best enjoyed with MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits such as starter pens and pod devices. Its 50VG/50PG blend ensures strong flavour clarity, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 5mg, 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Pod Salt Core Nic Salts are produced in the UK and designed for vapers seeking consistency, quality and great-tasting flavours that are familiar yet wildly creative.
